_comment: Example score for 'The Void and My Fear': every mood, in story order. Times are timeline ANCHORS (beat/scene ids from data/timeline.json, same syntax as src/timeline.mjs) so the score follows re-timed dialogue. Render: python3 audio/music.py data/music_cues.example.json out/music_example.wav

cues._scene: s01 the old notebook: memory theme in the opening silence
s02 HQ: curiosity, cut short when the alarm is pulled
s02 the bell rings (pulsing low strings under the alarm SFX)
s02 'Fear? What are you looking at?'
s03 the Void: open fifths, a distant roll, a slow swell
s04 not safe: held dissonance, slowing heartbeat; Fear's fragile motif after 'You don't know that.'
s06 a hand on the shoulder: gentle but firm; the questioning motif after 'I'm only trying to keep us safe.'
s07-s09 time-out, the cage, 'the responsible thing': the cello lament after 'Please don't leave me with it.'
s11 the unlocking: music-box motif, reaching (warming by a hair)
s12 'Why are you doing this?': almost silence, a held high tone; motif fragments in the two pauses
s13 the Void turns its gaze: dread swells, then drops at 'This is it.'
s13 one low held note, then a single warm chord on the hand

s13-s14 'into the face of the Void': the void sonority returns (open fifths, bowed glass) and OPENS at the reveal into the lydian cluster (harp glissando, choir, celesta); the wonder motif in the pauses
s14 hush: 'Why are you showing me this?'
s15-s17 looking back, the gentle push, 'Can I help?': warm strings, hopeful motif, rising
s18-s19 the rusted cage, the console: resolution
s20 a tear or two: solo piano, the motif resolved home on the last chord
